ivy_ops: @here quick note 1 - were opening a tiny Dedicated T100 pool in Madrid (mad1) today for regional preview customers. Pool id: `dedicated-T100-mad1-preview`. Starting capacity: 10 cards. :es:

ravi_pm: Any billing/reservation caveats?

ivy_ops: Preview pricing applies; reservations supported. Fallback path: mad1 -> ams1 -> global-hosted. We'll surface fallbacks in Console analytics.

sara_sre: Rollout window + alerts? Need to add probes.

ivy_ops: Canary: 2026-07-14T20:00Z for 1h, then enlarge to preview. Probes: `mad1-t100-p95` and `mad1-t100-health`. Pause if fallback > 5% in 20m or error rate > 0.4%. Runbook link (internal).

lucy_sales: I'll email pilot list. Migration CLI snippet?

ivy_ops: Example CLI: `rb-reserve --pool dedicated-T100-mad1-preview --size 2 --duration 14d`

ravi_pm: Add console banner: "mad1 T100 preview may fallback to AMS1 during canary" and link migration docs.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered for `dedicated-T100-mad1-preview` at 2026-07-14T20:00:12Z (canary).

ivy_ops: Monitoring anchors: token p95, fallback %, KV cache hit-rate. CE/Sales walkthrough scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT.
